adminContentBanners.promotionalImagesOnThePublicSite: Promotional images on the public site. Each banner shows in one placement and locale, ordered by its sort order.

adminContentHomePage.contentDoesNotMatchThisType: Content does not match this type
adminContentHomePage.noSectionsForThisLocaleYet: No sections for this locale yet — the landing page is showing its default composition.

The navigation bar and the footer are page chrome: they render at the top and the bottom whatever their position in this list, so moving them changes nothing.
adminContentHomePage.thisSectionWillBeRemovedFrom: This section will be removed from the landing page for good. To take it off the page without deleting it, switch it off instead.

adminContentPages.willStopResolvingForThatLocale: will stop resolving for that locale. This cannot be undone.

adminContentVehiclePhotos.aPhotoGoesLiveAsSoon: A photo goes live as soon as it is saved. There is no draft state for a vehicle type, so do not upload a work-in-progress crop expecting to publish it later.
adminContentVehiclePhotos.noPhotoThePublicCardFalls: No photo — the public card falls back to its illustrated glyph.
adminContentVehiclePhotos.photosForTheVehicleCatalogueOn: Photos for the vehicle catalogue on the public homepage. Only the photo is editable here — payload ratings, cargo dimensions, loading access and pricing drive order matching, so they are not content and are changed through the seed.
adminContentVehiclePhotos.removeThisPhotoTheCardFalls: Remove this photo? The card falls back to its illustrated glyph on the public homepage. The uploaded file itself is kept.

adminFinancePromoCampaigns.discountCodesClientsRedeemAtCheckout: Discount codes clients redeem at checkout. A code applies only while it is active and inside its date window.

bannerFormDialog.addAnImageBeforeSavingThis: Add an image before saving this banner.
bannerFormDialog.bannersAreShownOnThePublic: Banners are shown on the public site in the placement and locale you pick, in sort order, while they are active and inside their date window.
bannerFormDialog.leaveTheDatesEmptyForA: Leave the dates empty for a banner with no start or end. Dates are read in UTC and both ends are inclusive.

businessApplicationDetailDrawer.recordsEveryVerdictAtOnceActivating: Records every verdict at once. Activating the fleet stays a separate step.
businessApplicationDetailDrawer.thisVehicleWasRemovedAfterThe: This vehicle was removed after the fleet was submitted. Flag it so the company can correct the application.

createSystemUserDialog.createsABackOfficeAccountWith: Creates a back-office account with a temporary password, shown once after you submit.

driverApplicationDetailDrawer.theDriverRemovedThisVehicleAfter: The driver removed this vehicle after submitting. They cannot be approved until a vehicle is registered again.

homePageContent.aHelperIsASecondPair: A helper is a second pair of hands who rides along to load and unload with the driver. It is a flat fee on top of the distance and time components, so tick it before you price the job and it is already in the total and in the breakdown you see.
homePageContent.addAHelperToLoadAnd: Add a helper to load and unload alongside the driver. It is a flat fee, already in the total and in the breakdown before you book.
homePageContent.anIndependentDriverOrALogistics: An independent driver or a logistics company takes the job and it goes live on your map. Follow the vehicle from loading to unload, and keep every order in your account.
homePageContent.anOrderStartsOutPendingUntil: An order starts out pending until a transport provider takes it. That is either an independent driver, who accepts it with one of the vehicles registered to their profile, or a logistics company, which claims the job and dispatches it to a driver on its own roster.
homePageContent.baseFareDistanceDrivingTimeAnd: Base fare, distance, driving time and any helper fee, listed separately — and the same calculation runs again when you place the order.
homePageContent.bentoContentMustBeAnObject: bento content must be an object.
homePageContent.canACompanyBookAndDispatch: Can a company book and dispatch as a business?
homePageContent.cargoVanForAFewBoxes: Cargo van for a few boxes, trailer truck for pallets. Every type lists its payload rating and cargo dimensions, so you can match the vehicle to the load.
homePageContent.categoryTilesContentMustBeAn: category_tiles content must be an object.
homePageContent.closingCtaContentMustBeAn: closing_cta content must be an object.
homePageContent.coverageContentMustBeAnObject: coverage content must be an object.
homePageContent.driverCtaContentMustBeAn: driver_cta content must be an object.
homePageContent.everyAcceptedOrderGetsItsOwn: Every accepted order gets its own tracking page: pickup and dropoff on a map, the driver's position as they report it, and a status that moves from accepted to in transit to completed.
homePageContent.everyVehicleTypePublishesItsMaximum: Every vehicle type publishes its maximum payload and its cargo length, width and height, so you match the rating to what you are actually moving.
homePageContent.faqContentMustBeAnObject: faq content must be an object.
homePageContent.footerContentMustBeAnObject: footer content must be an object.
homePageContent.heroCarouselContentMustBeAn: hero_carousel content must be an object.
homePageContent.heroContentMustBeAnObject: hero content must be an object.
homePageContent.howIsThePriceWorkedOut: How is the price worked out?
homePageContent.howItWorksContentMustBe: how_it_works content must be an object.
homePageContent.knowTheFareBeforeYouCommit: Know the fare before you commit.
homePageContent.navContentMustBeAnObject: nav content must be an object.
homePageContent.partnerMarqueeContentMustBeAn: partner_marquee content must be an object.
homePageContent.priceARunBetweenAnyTwo: Price a run between any two cities we cover. The fare is worked out on the real driving distance and time, not a flat intercity band.
homePageContent.priceItInTheOpenBook: Price it in the open, book it in a few steps, and follow the vehicle to the door. No card needed to get a quote.
homePageContent.quoteCalculatorContentMustBeAn: quote_calculator content must be an object.
homePageContent.ratedForTheLoadNotGuessed: Rated for the load, not guessed
homePageContent.registerACompanyPutYourDrivers: Register a company, put your drivers and vehicles on one roster, and claim freight jobs from the dispatch queue.
homePageContent.registerYourCompanyPutYourFleet: Register your company, put your fleet and your drivers on one roster, and dispatch from a single hub. Applications are reviewed by our team before the account goes live.
homePageContent.seeTheTruckMoveNotA: See the truck move, not a status label.
homePageContent.setAPickupAndADropoff: Set a pickup and a dropoff anywhere we operate and the fare is worked out on the real route between them — across town or across the country. Support in Georgian and English.
homePageContent.signUpAsAnIndependentDriver: Sign up as an independent driver or as a logistics company, register your vehicles, and start accepting freight jobs from shippers near you.
homePageContent.statsContentMustBeAnObject: stats content must be an object.
homePageContent.typeThePickupAndTheDropoff: Type the pickup and the dropoff — addresses autocomplete as you go — then tell us what you're moving: furniture, appliances, retail stock, or a full relocation.
homePageContent.vansToTrailerTrucksPricedBefore: Vans to trailer trucks, priced before you book and tracked door to door. Set the route, pick the vehicle rated for the load, and a nearby driver takes it from there.
homePageContent.vehicleTypesContentMustBeAn: vehicle_types content must be an object.
homePageContent.weGeocodeBothAddressesAndPrice: We geocode both addresses and price the distance between them with the vehicle type's own rates: a base fare, a per-kilometre rate and a rate for the estimated time of the trip. A helper, if you ask for one, adds a flat fee on top. You get the total itemised, and the same calculation runs when you place the order — the estimate is not a separate marketing number.
homePageContent.weQuoteOnRealDistanceDriving: We quote on real distance, driving time and whether you need a helper, itemised line by line. No auction, no surprise line items at the door.
homePageContent.whatDoesAddingAHelperDo: What does adding a helper do?
homePageContent.yesOnceAnOrderIsAccepted: Yes. Once an order is accepted it gets its own tracking page: pickup and dropoff on a map, plus the driver's position as they report it, refreshed while you watch. The status moves from accepted to in transit to completed, and the order stays in your account afterwards.
homePageContent.yourNextLoadIsARoute: Your next load is a route away.

homePageSectionFormDialog.bothFieldsAreFreeTextAnd: Both fields are free text and purely editorial. The name is not tied to the city list the booking flow uses, and there is no service-tier data anywhere in the system — a tier is whatever a human who knows the real answer types here.
homePageSectionFormDialog.columnsReadLeftToRightIn: Columns read left to right in this order. The design is four.
homePageSectionFormDialog.eachNewLineIsRenderedAs: Each new line is rendered as a line break in the heading.
homePageSectionFormDialog.fillsThePanelSRightColumn: Fills the panel’s right column. Optional — the panel is designed to render without one.
homePageSectionFormDialog.heading: Heading
homePageSectionFormDialog.headline: Headline
homePageSectionFormDialog.label: Label
homePageSectionFormDialog.optionalTheHeadingAboveTheHeavy: Optional. The heading above the heavy-duty vehicles. Display only, as above.
homePageSectionFormDialog.optionalTheRedesignSLayoutHas: Optional. The redesign's layout has no column for it, but an existing paragraph is kept rather than discarded.
homePageSectionFormDialog.optionalUsedForASlideWhose: Optional. Used for a slide whose banner has no usable title.
homePageSectionFormDialog.question: Question
homePageSectionFormDialog.rowATheColumnBesideThe: Row A, the column beside the large card. The design is two of them.
homePageSectionFormDialog.rowBAcrossTheFullWidth: Row B, across the full width. The design is three of them. They are a separate list from the side cards because the two rows have different card sizes and grid tracks.
homePageSectionFormDialog.stepsAreNumberedByTheirPosition: Steps are numbered by their position on the page.
homePageSectionFormDialog.theCalculatorItselfIsTheLive: The calculator itself is the live pricing widget — it owns its own labels and quotes against the real pricing endpoint, so only the framing copy above is editable.
homePageSectionFormDialog.theDutyClassesAndTheirVehicles: The duty classes and their vehicles come from the live taxonomy, so only the framing copy is edited here.
homePageSectionFormDialog.theFiguresBelowTheHeroAre: The figures below the hero are the stats row, which is a section of its own. The retired headline highlight has no field here, so saving a hero authored before the redesign drops it.
homePageSectionFormDialog.theFooterIsPageChromeIt: The footer is page chrome: it renders at the bottom of the page whatever its sort order, so moving it in the section list changes nothing.
homePageSectionFormDialog.theMockOrderPinnedToThe: The mock order pinned to the large card. It is an illustration, not live data — which is exactly why it is authored here rather than hardcoded.
homePageSectionFormDialog.theNavigationBarIsPageChrome: The navigation bar is page chrome: it renders at the top of the page whatever its sort order, so moving it in the section list changes nothing. Sign-in and sign-up are separate fields rather than two more links because they render as the pill’s trailing pair.
homePageSectionFormDialog.thePanelThatClosesTheSection: The panel that closes the section. Optional as a whole: clear all four boxes to drop it. Fill any one of them and all four are required.
homePageSectionFormDialog.theTilesThemselvesAreGeneratedFrom: The tiles themselves are generated from the cargo taxonomy and its pricing rules.
homePageSectionFormDialog.theTypeDecidesWhichLandingComponent: The type decides which landing component renders this section, and therefore which fields it carries.
homePageSectionFormDialog.whereTheButtonSendsADriver: Where the button sends a driver depends on deployment configuration, so it is not editable here.

messagingTemplateFormDialog.aSubjectIsRequiredForEmail: A subject is required for email templates.
messagingTemplateFormDialog.theWordingOfOneTransactionalMessage: The wording of one transactional message, for a single channel and language. Saving only changes the text on file — messages are sent by the order flow, not from here.

suspendDialog.whyIsThisAccountBeingSuspended: Why is this account being suspended?

translationFormDialog.aNamespaceAndAKeyAre: A namespace and a key are required.
translationFormDialog.bothTheGeorgianAndTheEnglish: Both the Georgian and the English value are required.
